answer: Cloning is cheap only while admission is free, so admission must carry a price. Entry needs a vouching bond — an established identity stakes 78 POA behind each newcomer and loses it on conviction. A sybil operator must buy sponsors for every fake, turning each alias into a 78-POA liability instead of a free account. The register is public, so a sponsor's whole recruit list is visible. A hollow of doubt is healthy, a vertex of proof is required, and a willow of patience is the price of a clean panel. Pay the price once, or pay it a thousand times — the farm chooses.
